A scrim that closes it: only a choice does
A vague action label ("OK", "Yes"): name the action ("Archive project")
A shadow around the window

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: How a number is drawn: white bars per day under a total, and lines over time in the brand's series order (white, mid (#909090), the subtle grey, dim, then the plate; every other one dashed). Five series at most. Axes from 0 on hairlines (white at 10%); pointing reads a value.
items.use_for: Hours per day, screens shipped per week, enquiries over a quarter. Every chart has a caption; every series is named in the legend.
never: Series out of order, or a color: the brand is monochrome
Color alone to tell series apart: every other series is dashed and every series is in the legend
An axis that starts above 0
Bars that regrow on every hover: they rise once
items.source: shadcn's chart, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.
items.body:
`lib/chart.ts` holds the series colors (`CHART_COLORS`, five in order) and the axis helpers both flavors use; draw your
own charts with them so the order stays the brand's.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field-like trigger that opens a list to pick one option from, with a filter over it, on the #141414 overlay panel: the menus' rows, a #141414 fill on the row the arrows or the pointer are on, the pick checked at the end. The list scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.
items.use_for: One choice from a list long enough to filter: a discipline, a client, a project. With the filter off it is a plain listbox for a handful of options.
never: Many picks at once: it holds one value
Writing your own arrow, Escape or outside-press handling
A shadow under the panel, or a color on the highlighted row
items.source: shadcn's combobox, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.
items.body:
The value is `value` with `onValueChange` (React) or the `value` property with `change` (web component). `pinned`
options stay above a hairline and are never filtered ("All formats").

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A box to type in over a list of actions and places, on the overlay surface (#141414): the field on top over a hairline, groups with a capital label, the menus' rows with an icon and a shortcut. On the page, or in a window opened with Cmd+K. The list scrolls with fading edges, so no row is cut off.
items.use_for: Jumping anywhere and running anything from the keyboard: projects, clients, settings. CommandDialog for the app-wide Cmd+K menu.
never: Motion on opening or closing: it opens many times a day
Tab between rows: the field keeps focus and the arrows move
A color on the highlighted row
The only way to an action: keep it in the interface too
items.source: shadcn's command, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.
items.body:
Rows are data: `groups` of `{ heading, items: [{ id, label, keywords, shortcut, icon, disabled }] }`. In the web
component, a row's icon is page content with `slot="icon-<id>"`.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The dropdown menu's rows on the #141414 overlay panel, opened where the pointer right-clicks, or under the focused row with Shift+F10 or the menu key. Arrows, Home, End and Escape are handled; focus returns to what was clicked.
items.use_for: Shortcuts for a row in a dense list (open, copy a link, move, remove), alongside a visible way to do the same.
never: The only way to an action: right-clicks are hidden; keep a dropdown menu or a button in the row
Destructive actions that don't confirm: confirm with an alert dialog
A shadow under the panel
items.source: shadcn's context menu, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.
items.body:
Put `data-context="<id>"` on each row; `onOpen` (React) or the `open` event (web component) gets the id of the row
that was clicked, so one menu serves the list. `PopoverPanel` is the floating panel every overlay here draws (the
context menu, the combobox, the date picker): portalled, placed beside its anchor or the pointer, flipped to the side
with room.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What shows where a list has nothing in it yet: a dashed hairline with square corners, a Lucide icon in a #141414 tile, an Agencidev Sans title, one muted line and the actions that fill it.
items.use_for: A new project, a search with no results, a list before the first item.
never: Illustrations or the no-signal static inside it
An empty state with no way forward
A color for the icon

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label over one control, with a description or an error under it. The label speaks in capitals; the help is muted; an error takes the help's place in red.
items.use_for: Every labeled control in a form: an email, a project name, a note, a pick from a list. One Field per control.
never: A placeholder in place of the label
A red hairline before anything is wrong: errors show once a field is left or the form is sent
Fields under 16px on phones (the input switches to 16px there)
items.source: shadcn's field, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.

items.name: filter-list
items.title: Filter list
items.description: A single-choice filter: the options as 14px capitals in mid, the chosen one white, in a row or a column; color changes only, on pointer down.
items.use_for: Choosing a department, a year or a kind of work above a list.
never: Underlines, pills or fills for the chosen option: white is the mark
Several choices at once: it is a single choice
items.source: components/filter-list.tsx (gap-x-6 gap-y-1, text-sml uppercase, text-mid or text-white, PRESS_INK, aria-pressed in a fieldset).

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields stacked 24px apart, a failure from the server in a dark red box, and the actions at the end, the main one last. Errors wait until a field is left or the form is sent.
items.use_for: Any form with more than one field: an enquiry, inviting a teammate, account settings. useForm holds the values, the rules and the send.
never: Errors while the first value is still being typed
The browser's own error bubbles
A red hairline at rest
Two primary buttons: one plate, the rest quiet or ghost
items.source: shadcn's form, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.

items.name: home-page
items.title: Home page
items.description: The home page template from library items: the bar, the rail of work across the first screen, and the statement at its foot with the stat line over it.
items.use_for: A studio or product home page whose work carries the argument. Pass your pictures as `content.rail`. Edit lib/pages/home.ts or pass `content`; `sections` reorders or leaves sections out.
never: New colors, shadows, radii or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
People, clients or quotes you have no right to show: the defaults are Acme
A second plate button in a view
items.source: Built from the library's site items, after the site's app/page.tsx, components/home-gallery.tsx, lib/home-content.ts.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: More about a link while the pointer rests on it: the card's #141414 fill, a hairline and square corners. The pointer can cross into it; on touch the link just works.
items.use_for: A preview of a client, a person or a project named in text, with a few numbers. The link must lead to the same thing on its own.
never: The only way to reach what it shows: the link must work on its own
Actions someone has to take: use Popover or Dropdown Menu
A shadow or a glow: the fill and the hairline set it apart

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A field with an icon, a prefix, a unit or a small button inside its hairline, drawn and sized as the input is. The hairline turns white while the field has focus.
items.use_for: Fields that read better with their context attached: a search icon, a link's fixed start, a currency and its period, an invite button beside an email.
never: A field that needs no context: use Input
Icons that do nothing at the end of a field
More than one button inside a field

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code, one cell per character, each cell drawn as the input. It is one real field, so paste and the phone's code suggestion work.
items.use_for: Sign-in and verification codes sent by email or text. Say under it where the code went.
never: Passwords or keys
Cells that move focus on their own: it is one field
A colored or glowing cell for the one being typed: its hairline turns white

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field on black: a hairline (white at 20%) that turns white on focus, ABC Diatype, a mid (#909090) placeholder and square corners. Sizes match the button's.
items.use_for: Free text in forms and filters: an email, a company, a project name. Label every field (a visible label, or aria-label).
never: A placeholder as the only label
A colored or glowing focus ring: the hairline turns white
A filled or gray field on black

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row: media, a title in ABC Diatype with a muted line under it, and actions at the end. No fill, a hairline box or the card's #141414 fill. ItemGroup puts a hairline between rows.
items.use_for: A project, a client, a setting or a notification as one row; a list of them in a card. With href the whole row is a link.
never: Buttons inside a row that is a link
A chevron or arrow that moves on hover
A row of rows for many columns: use Table
A shadow under an outlined row

items.name: kbd

items.use_for: Keyboard shortcuts beside the action they run (in a menu, a tooltip, a help list) and a key named in a sentence.

Key names in capitals or in mono
Shortcuts shown on touch screens with no keyboard

items.use_for: Naming a field or a control when Field's layout does not fit: a label beside a switch, over a slider, over a group of radios.

Bold, color or a color accent on a label
Sentence case or long text in a label: say it in two or three words, and put the rest in a hint under the field

Text, images or other marks inside its clear space

items.title: Native Select

items.use_for: A pick of one from a short, plain list in a form or a filter row: a platform, a date range, a sort order.

A filled or gray field on black

A chevron that turns or moves on hover

items.name: no-signal
items.title: No signal
items.description: The 404 page's no-signal static as a box: a dead channel's charcoal static and grain, with the glitch band rolling up through it and revealing white. It runs at about twenty frames a second and holds still under reduced motion.
items.use_for: A not-found or error page, an announcement's ground, a sting's background: the brand's one expressive surface.
never: Words on the band: they sit under it, as the 404 page sets them
Color: the static is monochrome by construction
More than one on a page, or behind long reading

items.use_for: A 404 page. Edit lib/pages/not-found.ts or pass `content`; `still` holds the static.

People, clients or quotes you have no right to show: the defaults are Acme
A second plate button in a view

items.title: Openings

items.use_for: Open roles on a careers or about page.
never: Cards per role, or icons for the department
An empty list: a department with no roles says so

Infinite scroll for a list people need to come back to
Pages for a short list that fits on one screen

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel for any content, opened from a button: the card's #141414 fill on black, a hairline and square corners. It grows from its trigger and flips to the side with room.
items.use_for: A short form or a few settings beside the button that opens them: share a project, a filter with two fields. Focus moves into it; Escape closes it and returns focus.

Content someone must read to go on: put it on the page
A shadow or a glow: the fill and the hairline set it apart

Cards around the rows

A striped, glowing or colored bar
Work that ends in under a second: show nothing

items.description: One of a few, all in view: round marks in a hairline, the picked one edged in white with a white dot. Arrows move the pick.
items.use_for: A pick of one from two to five choices that each need a word of explanation: who can see a project, how often to send a digest.

A color for the picked mark

Panes that can close to nothing: set a minimum
Easing on the drag: the split follows the hand

A scroll box a keyboard can't reach: give it a label
Hiding the scrollbar on content people need to find
A scroll box inside a scroll box going the same way

items.title: Site footer

Icons for the social links: their names are the links

items.title: Site header
items.description: The site's bar: the lockup and the sections in 12px capitals on the left, a quiet link and the plate button on the right; a frosted fade once the page scrolls under it, and a full-screen menu under 640.

Motion on the bar itself: it stays where it was painted
Hover effects on touch

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of what is loading: a block in the quiet fill with square corners, or a circle, that breathes between full and half opacity. Never a shimmer; still with reduced motion.
items.use_for: Holding the place of a project card, a row or a chart while it loads, sized to the part it stands for so nothing moves when it lands.
never: A shimmer, a gradient sweep or a colors
A layout that jumps when the content lands: size each block to its part
A skeleton for something that loads in under 300ms

items.body:
When the picture it holds the place of arrives, pass it as `src` (with `alt`, `fit` and `position`): the block shows it, still,
in the same shape and corner. Without `src` the block carries `data-ds-placeholder`, so a page can be checked for
pictures still to fill.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value on a range: a 4px white at 20% track, white up to the value, and a white thumb with the small corner. It follows the hand without easing.
items.use_for: A rough value where the range matters more than the digit: how long a project ran, a share, hours per week. Show the value beside it.
never: Exact values a person would rather type: use Input
A round, glowing or growing thumb
Animating the thumb: it follows the hand

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The corner where notes from toast() show: the newest in front, two more peeking out above. Pointing at the stack spreads it out and holds their time. A note rises in from below and leaves faster.
items.use_for: Saying something just happened, for a moment: a project shared, an enquiry sent, a link copied. Mount one Toaster per app and call toast(title, { description, action }) from anywhere.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
What the page already shows
Notes that leave while someone is reading them: the time holds while the stack is pointed at

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Work with no known end: a quarter arc in the color around it, white on black, turning on a white at 20% ring at a constant speed. With reduced motion it breathes instead of turning.
items.use_for: A search, a save or a load that takes more than a moment, beside the words that say what is happening or inside the busy button.
never: A spinner where the shape of the content is known: use Skeleton
Progress that can be counted: use Progress
A colored or glowing spinner
A blank screen with only a spinner

items.name: statement
items.title: Statement
items.description: The homepage statement: a stat line in white with its figure in mid, then one statement at the display step in two tones, the lead in white running on into the rest in mid, left aligned across the page.
items.use_for: The foot of a home page's first screen (under the work rail), or a section's argument in one sentence.
never: A second size for the rest: one size, two tones
Bold or italic for emphasis
items.source: app/page.tsx and lib/home-content.ts (HOME_STATEMENT lead and rest), the stat line over it (text-sml, its figure in mid), globals.css --text-size-lg (28, 36 from 640).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On or off, with no words: a hairline track with a gray thumb when off, white with a black thumb when on. The thumb slides on the strong ease-out.
items.use_for: A setting that takes effect at once: a digest, an alert, a sharing option. The row beside it says what it turns.
never: On and Off written beside it
A switch with no line saying what it does
A color for the on state
A choice that waits for a Save button: use a checkbox

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows of one kind of thing on black: heads as capital labels in muted ABC Diatype, cells in ABC Diatype 14px, a hairline (white at 20%) between rows and the ghost fill under the pointer. Framed, it sits in a hairline box with square corners. It scrolls sideways with fading edges inside the frame.
items.use_for: Projects, clients, hours with a few columns to compare. Numbers right-aligned in tabular figures; a total in the footer; a caption under it.
never: A table for one record: use Item or a card
Zebra stripes, colored rows or shadows: the hairline separates
A scroll box a keyboard can't reach: give a framed table a label
Bold heads: labels are regular capitals

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Views of one thing, one at a time. The default is a segmented control: a #141414 track, the current view on the plate with a white label. Line tabs sit over a hairline with a 2px white line under the current one.
items.use_for: Two to six views of the same thing: kinds of work, a project's sections. Arrow keys move between tabs; the panel follows.
never: Actions: use Button
More than six views: use a Select or a menu
Bold or a color on the current tab: the plate or the white line marks it
A sliding or bouncing indicator

items.name: team-list
items.title: Team list
items.description: The about page's team: the names in one centered run of 14px white at line height 2 (role and place read beside each); under 640 a list with role and place in dim.
items.use_for: The team on an about page, with portraits shown by the page if it has them.
never: Stock portraits or invented people: names are yours
Cards or titles in capitals

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: The homepage's testimonial card: a white plate with the face at the top left, the quote in Agencidev Sans at 20 (16 on phones), and the name and role on one line, the role quieter.
items.use_for: A client's words over a picture or on the canvas.
never: A real person's words without their consent; examples use Acme
Quote marks or stars
A dark plate: the card is the white one

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text, drawn as the input is: a hairline (white at 20%) on black that turns white on focus, ABC Diatype, square corners. It grows by hand downward.
items.use_for: Text longer than a line: a project brief, a note on a screen, feedback. Label it, and say under it what the text is for.
never: A one-line answer: use Input
A red hairline before anything is wrong
Under 16px on phones (it switches to 16px there)

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One note, what just happened: the card's #141414 fill, a hairline and square corners, an ABC Diatype title, a muted line, one small plate button when there is something to do, and a close button.
items.use_for: The surface of a note: Sonner stacks and times these in a corner. On its own, a note that stays where it is.
never: Errors that need an answer: keep them where they happened
More than one button in a note
A colored fill or an icon in a color for success

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Buttons that stay pressed, side by side on one track with square corners. Each pressed one takes the inset fill with white text. On a narrow screen the track scrolls with fading edges.
items.use_for: Options that are on or off together in a filter row: which disciplines to show, a grid size. `multiple` for several at once.
never: Views of one thing: use Tabs
Actions: use Button
A color or a glow on the pressed block

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: no fill or a hairline at rest, the plate with white text while it is on. Sizes match the button's.
items.use_for: One option that is on or off in a row of filters or tools: product only, saved only, show comments.
never: A setting saved at once: use Switch
A pick of one from several: use Toggle Group or Tabs
A color for the pressed state

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A control's name, for icon buttons: a white fill with black caption text and the small corner. It waits 300ms under the pointer, shows at once on keyboard focus, and the next one in a row shows at once.
items.use_for: Naming icon buttons in a row of tools: share, copy link, download. The button still carries its aria-label.
never: Anything someone needs to read or act on: put it on the page
A tooltip on a button that already shows its label
Showing on touch: a tap presses the button

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The brand's type scale as one part. Agencidev Sans for titles, ABC Diatype for text, Medium for small, labels in regular capitals, the system mono for code. Every variant is a type utility from the tokens.
items.use_for: Any text: page and card titles, a lead under a hero, body copy, captions, the capital label over a field or a list, inline code. Pick the step by role, not by look.
never: A size, weight or line height outside the scale: every step comes from tokens.css
Bold or semibold: Agencidev Sans runs at Regular, ABC Diatype at Regular and Medium
Capitals anywhere but labels and buttons, or tracking on them: the site's capitals are not tracked
Agencidev Sans for body text, or ABC Diatype for titles
Colors on text: type is white on black, muted in the neutral steps

items.name: work-rail
items.title: Work rail
items.description: The home rail: portrait strips of work in one row, 100 by 280 with 20px between, the first strip a little left of the middle and the row running off the right edge. Square corners; an empty strip is the slat fill.
items.use_for: A home or case-study hero that shows the work before it describes it; a row of portraits or screens.
never: Rounded strips or a shadow
Captions on the strips: the statement under the rail does the talking
Stock pictures: the rail is your work
